Related insight: Related insight: Tutorial 10 (wasp_10) is the direct successor to tutorial 09 — it continues the further aggregation techniques progression, introducing graph-based and multi-part connection configuration techniques. The tutorial sequence from 07 onward — 07 → 08 → 09 → 10 — represents a sustained deepening of discrete-element aggregation complexity. Tutorial 09 is the direct prerequisite for understanding the further aggregation techniques explored in tutorial 10.

Related insight: Related insight: The aggregation techniques progression continues well beyond tutorial 10, with the series advancing through tutorials 11, 12, 13, and into tutorial 14 (wasp_14), which covers advanced topics in discrete assembly. Tutorial 09 is an early prerequisite in this extended learning path.

Related insight: Related insight: The aggregation techniques progression extends further still, with the series now confirmed to advance through tutorial 15 (wasp_15), which continues advanced topics in modular, rules-based discrete assembly. Tutorial 09 is an early prerequisite in this extended learning path.

Related insight: Related insight: The aggregation techniques progression that runs through tutorial 09 extends well beyond tutorial 15, continuing into a dedicated constraints sub-series that includes tutorial 29 (wasp_29), which covers constraint-based stochastic aggregation with adjacency and connection-configuration rules. Tutorial 09 is an early prerequisite in this extended learning path.

Related insight: Related insight: The aggregation techniques progression that runs through tutorial 09 extends further still, with the constraints sub-series now confirmed to advance through tutorial 31 (wasp_31), which continues constraint-based aggregation with plane-constraint techniques. Tutorial 09 is an early prerequisite in this extended learning path (... → wasp_28 → wasp_29 → wasp_30 → wasp_31).

The 'graph' tag is added since wasp_10 introduces graph-related aggregation concepts that likely build on or relate to techniques in wasp_09.

wasp_09 currently documents the sequence up to tutorial 10. Noting that the series extends to tutorial 14 gives learners a fuller picture of the tutorial progression and positions tutorial 09 correctly within the broader learning path.

wasp_09's context previously noted the series extended to tutorial 14. Now that tutorial 15 exists, the context should be updated to reflect the full known extent of the series. Tags 'modular' and 'rules-based' from wasp_15 are also relevant to wasp_09's content.
wasp_29 extends the known series beyond what was previously documented in wasp_09's context.
wasp_31 extends the constraints sub-series further, and wasp_09's context should be updated to reflect that the series now reaches tutorial 31.

curriculum.title: Part Catalog
curriculum.text:
Part Catalog
This component allows you to control the number of different Part types in
an Aggregation. The different inputs allows you to control how this is achieved:
- LIM defines if the catalog is 'limited" (the aggregation will stop when the given
  numbers of parts are reached) or "proportional (the aggregation  will place all 
  required parts, and the Catalog values will be used as proportions).
- AD, when LIM is set to False, allows the Catalog to be "adaptive" (meaning it
  will adapt the part numbers internally according to the number of placed parts).
  This allows to have more accurate results in some cases, particularly when using
  field-driven aggregations.
